name: Dalian Runguang Science and Technology Co., Ltd.

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel-reported Member State allegation; publication records the response status as pending.

caveats: Money-laundering language is an allegation relayed by a Member State; the report's legal posture remains an allegation.
The Panel had not received a reply from Dalian Runguang at publication.

statements: A Member State alleged that Dalian-based manager Ma Tong Hyok brought Munitions Industry Department-subordinate IT workers to China and that Dalian Runguang knowingly worked with him and DPRK IT workers while laundering money for the DPRK.

sources.support: Supports the manager, company, worker-dispatch and laundering allegation, plus no-reply status
